::: {#def-bipartite-npsem-ie .theorem}
## Bipartite random network NPSEM \[BRNNPSEM\]

An [RNNPSEM](#def-npsem-ne) that represents a causal system with two classes of [observational unit](#def-observational-unit), $\mathcal P$ and $\mathcal Q$, for example people and places, and edges only between classes: its structural equations fall into two groups, one for each class, and its graph generators produce bipartite graphs:

$$
\psi(i,j) > 0 \;\Rightarrow\; i \text{ and } j \text{ are in distinct classes}.
$$

For each graph generator, the [network weights](#def-graph) of a unit $i \in \mathcal P$, $\Psi_i = [\,\psi(i,j)\,]_{j \in \mathcal Q}$, belong to its [observational unit](#def-observational-unit), so that their equations are structural equations:

$$
\Psi_i \subset \mathscr{O}_i, \qquad \mathbf V = \bigcup_{i \in \mathcal N} \mathscr{O}_i.
$$
:::
